title: Cut the local suite's hour: prebuilt dist for spawned CLIs, shared git fixtures, spawn-heavy tier
body: The 2026-08-30 machinery audit measured the full vitest suite at ~37 min idle / ~52 min contended, with a cumulative ~32 min of worker CPU spent on transform-on-import alone and dozens of tests spawning real subprocess trees (git-init fixtures, bash, tsx CLIs, MCP servers) that flake with spawnSync ETIMEDOUT under load. Three levers, roughly in value order: (1) a prebuilt dist the spawned CLIs run from, killing the per-spawn tsx cold start; (2) shared/cached git fixture repos instead of per-test git init; (3) split spawn-heavy files into their own tier or shard locally the way scripts/ci-test-groups.ts already does for CI. Success = full local suite under ~20 min idle with no ETIMEDOUT flakes at normal load.
